name: Scrappy Craft
languages: English, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, German, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Traditional Chinese, Turkish
short: A shop keeper game where you run a small forge. Scavenge trash and combine it to craft over 10,000 absurd weapons like banana swords or frisbee shields, buy upgrades, unlock new recipes, and sell your bizarre creations to quirky customers like tie-wearing otters or spaghetti monsters.
about: Welcome to a forge where trash becomes treasure. Mix and match scraps to create thousands of wildly unconventional weapons, upgrade your shop, and expand your crafting arsenal with new recipes. Satisfy a cast of eccentric customers like dragons, grandmas, penguins, robots, and a lot more.        Scour piles of trash and uncover the perfect scraps to forge your next weapon.                 Use what you find to craft the most creative weapons. Make Pony Hammers and Cookie Shields.                 Sell your creations to puppies, gnomes, monsters and more!                 Upgrade your forge by buying all sorts of trinkets from Diogenes the Raccoon.          Features   Search through trash to find crafting materials   Combine items to create absurd weapons   Play minigames to perfect your creations   Sell your weapons to strange and memorable customers   Upgrade your forge and automate your trash-powered operation
min_req: Minimum:     OS:  Windows 10    Processor:  2 cores, from 2013 or later    Memory:  4 GB RAM    Graphics:  Integrated Graphics    Storage:  200 MB available space
